headline: Premco Global offers highest one-year dividend yield among select textile stocks
hook: Premco leads textile sector dividend race
summary: Indian textile stocks are gaining attention due to supply-chain shifts, policy backing, and trade access. Premco Global recorded the highest one-year dividend yield at 9.5%, supported by a special dividend payout. Other textile companies featuring in the dividend race include Monte Carlo, Siyaram's, and Ambika Cotton. Retail investors tracking the textile sector can evaluate cash returns alongside broader industry tailwinds.
why_it_matters: Higher dividend payouts boost total returns for textile stock investors

headline: TCS, JSW Paints, and four others declare special dividends for shareholders
hook: Six listed firms announce extra cash rewards
summary: Six Indian companies including Tata Consultancy Services, JSW Dulux, Premco Global, and Honda India Power Products have announced special dividends for their shareholders. These extra payouts come in addition to regular interim or final dividends distributed by the companies. Retail investors holding shares in these firms as of the respective record dates will receive the additional cash payouts. Such corporate actions directly reward long-term equity holders with extra cash flow.
whats_next: Upcoming record dates and dividend payment schedules for each stock
why_it_matters: Extra cash credited directly to shareholder bank accounts soon.
winners_losers: Existing shareholders gain / non-holders miss out
